paite: David hong upa in, ahong tek mahmahta hi. Huchi in puan in akhuh zel ua, himahleh lum asa thei tuan kei hi.
heading: Kumpipa David Ahong Upata

paite: Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa a ding in nungak zong le ungla; kumpipa kiangchin ah om gige henla, kemleh; na angsung ah hong lumleh, ka toupa kumpipa'n lum ahon sa thei ding," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel gam tengteng ah nungak melhoih azong ua, Shunam mi Abishag ava mu ua, kumpipa kiang ah api uhi.
Huai nungak amel ahoih mahmah a, kumpipa akem a, anek-tak abawlsak hi. Himahleh, kumpipa'n amah akithuahpih kei hi.
Haggith tapa Adonijah in, "Kei kumpipa a pang ding ka hi ve," chi in akingai thupi mahmah hi. Kangtalai leh sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga ama a tai dingte toh akisasak hi.
heading: Adonijah In Laltutphah Atuh

paite: Apa'n lah chik lai in leng, "Bangziak a hichibang a hih na hia?" chi in alungkhamsak ngei kei hi. Amah melhoih mahmah a, Absalom sangpa ahi.
Ama'n Zeruiah tapa Joab leh siampu Abiathar thu adong a; amau Adonijah lam ah apang ua, amah apanpih uhi.
Siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, zawlnei Nathan, Shimei, Rei leh David pawl a mihangsante bel Adonijah lam ah apang kei uhi.
Adonijah in belamte, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute Zoheleth' Suang ah agou a, huai tuh En-rogel kiangchin a om ahi. Kumpipa tapate, a-unau tengteng leh Judah gam a kumpipa sikha tengteng achial hi.
Zawlnei Nathan, Benaiah, mihangsante leh a-unaupa Solomon bel achial kei hi.
Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah, "Haggith tapa Adonijah, i toupa David theih louh in vaihawm in a-om chih za lou na hi maw?
heading: Kumpipa A Solomon Bawl Ahi

paite: Na bitna ding leh na tapa Solomon bitna ding ka hon hilh ding.

Kumpipa David kiang ah va lut inla, akiang ah, Aw toupa, ka kumpipa, na sikhanu kiang ah na tapa Solomon, ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei dia, amah ka laltutphah ah atu ding, chi in na kichiam ahi kei maw? Bang achia Adonijah in vaihawm ahia?" va chi dih achi hi.
"Ngai in, kumpipa na va houpih laitak in ke'n leng ka hon zui lut sam dia, na thugen ka hon hihkippih ding," chi in agen hi.
Bathsheba kumpipa kiang ah indan ah ava lut a; kumpipa a-upa mahmahta a, Shunam mi Abishag in kumpipa nek-tak a na bawl hi.
Bathsheba in kumpipa kun in zahtakna apia hi. Kumpipa'n, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka toupa aw, TOUPA na Pathian min lou in na sikhanu kiang ah, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding a, amah ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi in na kichiam khinta hi.
Ngai in, tu in Adonijah lah alal a; nang ka kumpipa toupa'n lah na thei kei hi.
Bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng leh siampu Abiathar leh sepaih heutu Joab achial a, na sikha Solomon achial kei hi.
Huchi in toupa aw, ka toupa nung a alaltutphah a kua hong tu ding ahia chih na gen ding in, Israelte tengteng mit nang ka toupa kumpipa tung ah atu hi.
Huchi lou in zaw hichi ahi ding a, toupa kumpipa apute kiang a a-ihmut sam hun chiang in, kei leh ka tapa Solomon thil hihkhial in ahon sep mai ding uh,” achi hi.
Ngai in, huchi a kumpipa ahoupih laitak in, zawlnei Nathan ava lut sam hi.
"En dih, zawlnei Nathan ahong," chi in kumpipa ahilh uh. Kumpipa kiang ava tun in, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
Nathan in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka nung ah Adonijah alal dia, ka laltutphah ah atu ding na chi maw?

Tuni in akuansuk a, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng, sepaih heutute leh siampu Abiathar achial hi. Ngai in, ane un adawnkhawm ua, Pathian in kumpipa Adonijah hondam hen, achi uh.
Himahleh kei na sikha ngei leh siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah leh na sikha Solomon ahon chial kei hi.
Hiai toupa ka kumpipa thu a hih ahih ngalleh toupa ka kumpipa'n anung a laltutphah a tu dingpa akua pen ahia chih na sikhate na hilh nai lou na hi ding maw?" achi hi.
Kumpipa David in adawng a, "Bathsheba hon sapsak dihua," achi hi. Kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh a, kumpipa ma ah ava dingh hi.
Kumpipa akichiam a, "Lungzinna tengteng a ka hinna humbitpa TOUPA ahin bang in,
na kiang a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian min lou a, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding. Ka sik in ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi a ka kichiam bang in, tuni in ka hih ding,” achi hi.
Bathsheba amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa zahtakna pia in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa David tangtawn in dam zel hen,” achi hi.
Kumpipa David in, "Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hon va sapsak dih ua," achi hi. Amau kumpipa ma ah ava pai uhi.
Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Na toupa uh sikhate pi unla, ka tapa Solomon keimah sabiltung mahmah ah tuangsak unla, Gihon ah pisuk un.
Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Israelte kumpipa ding in thau nilh uhen. Pengkul mut unla, Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen, chi un.
Huchi in amah na zuitou ding ua, ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding hi; amah lah ka sik a lal ding ahi ngal a. Amah Israel gam leh Judah gam vaihawmtu dia ka seh ahi,” achi hi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in kumpipa adawng a, "Amen, TOUPA, ka toupa kumpipa Pathian in leng pha sa hen.
TOUPA ka toupa kumpipa kiang a a-om bang in, Solomon kiang ah leng om sam henla, ka toupa kumpipa David laltutphah sang in alaltutphah hih thupizaw hen," achi hi.
Huchi in siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite ahohsuk ua, David sabiltung tung ah Solomon atuangsak ua, Gihon ah api uhi.
Siampu Zadok in puanin a pan thau koihna ala a, Solomon anilh hi. Pengkul amut ua, huchi in mi tengteng in, "Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen," achi uhi.
Mi tengteng in amah azuitou ua, mite'n tamngaite atum ua, akipak mahmah ua, ahusa ging un lei akheng hi.
Adonijah leh amichial, akiang a om tengteng in ankuang alui khit un aza ua, Joab in pengkul mutging azak in, "Khopi sung a husa ging zuazua bangchidan ahia le?" achi hi.
Huai achih laitak in, ngai in, siampu Abiathar tapa Jonathan ava hoh a, Adonijah in, "Hong pai dih ve, nang zaw mikizen na hi a, tanchinhoih na hon tun mahmah ding," ana chi hi.
Jonathan in adawng a, Adonijah kiang ah, "Tun ke'ng e, toupa aw, kumpipa David in Solomon kumpipa in abawl khinta hi.
Amah toh siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite kumpipa'n asawl a, kumpipa sabiltung tung ah atuangsak uhi.
Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Gihon ah kumpipa ding in thau anilh uh. Huai a pan nuamsatak in apaitou ua, huai in khopi sung athawn zuazua hi. Husa na zak uh huai ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon leng lalgam tutphah ah atuta hi.

Kumpipa sikhate i toupa kumpipa David vualzawl ding in ahong ua, "Pathian in na min sang in Solomon min hihhoih zaw henla, na laltutphah sang in ama laltutphah hih thupizaw hen,” ahong chi uh. Huchi in kumpipa lupna tung ah akun hi.
Kumpipa'n leng, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, tuni mahmah a ka laltutphah a tu ding hon pepa phat in om hen. Ka mit mahmah in amuta,” achi hi.
Adonijah michial tengteng in alauta ua, athou ua, alampi chiat uah apaivekta uhi.
Adonijah in Solomon alau a, athou a, maitam kii ava len hi.
"Ngai in, Adonijah in kumpipa Solomon alau a; kumpipa Solomon in asikha namsau a that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam phot hen," chi in maitam kii alen hi chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
Solomon in, "Miginomtak ahih asuklat peuhmahleh asamzang khat leng lei ah ake kei ding. Gitlouhna anei chih theihna a-omleh bel asi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in mi asawl a, maitam a pan ava pisuk ua, amah ava hoh a, kumpipa Solomon ma ah akun hi. Solomon in akiang ah, "Na inn ah pai in," ana chi hi.
